# ForeverLM

> ForeverLM is a macOS app for building a personal learning knowledge base and reviewing it with AI. Instead of just flipping cards, it uses explain-it-back review: you explain concepts from scratch, and an AI evaluates your understanding, asks targeted follow-up questions, and only advances you when you actually get it. Your knowledge base lives in your private iCloud container on your Mac and in your iCloud account. External-assistant MCP traffic passes through ForeverLM-operated Cloudflare infrastructure.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.foreverlm.com/index): Product overview and starting points.
- [Why Quizzing?](https://docs.foreverlm.com/why-quizzing): Why retrieval and explanation improve learning.
- [macOS App](https://docs.foreverlm.com/macos-app): Install and use the native Mac app.
- [Web Library](https://docs.foreverlm.com/web-library): Access the synced library from the web.

## MCP Server

- [Connect an AI Assistant](https://docs.foreverlm.com/setup-mcp): Claude custom connector (not in the Claude Directory yet); ChatGPT plugin in review; Grok custom connector at grok.com/connectors. Codex, Gemini, and Claude Code use a copied setup prompt.
- [Drag & Drop](https://docs.foreverlm.com/drag-and-drop): Move sources into an assistant conversation directly.
- [MCP Tools Reference](https://docs.foreverlm.com/mcp-tools): Complete ForeverLM MCP tool surface.

## Adding Content

- [Studio](https://docs.foreverlm.com/studio): Notebooks (the Notebooks home, a notebook's Sources, Chat and Studio, Add sources), the full-window Library, the Reader, in-app Chat, Memory, semantic search, and source review state.
- [Teams](https://docs.foreverlm.com/teams): Shared team libraries in the creator's iCloud: inviting members, sharing sources, notebooks, Pages and chat transcripts by copy, and the notebook task board.
- [Articles](https://docs.foreverlm.com/articles): Auto-discover articles from browser reading lists or paste URLs manually.
- [Papers](https://docs.foreverlm.com/papers): Academic paper URLs are detected automatically and routed to Papers. Save paywalled PDFs to iCloud for automatic local fallback.
- [Journals](https://docs.foreverlm.com/journals): Follow journal feeds; new articles are read against your notebooks and offered as suggestions you accept or dismiss, never imported unasked.
- [Books](https://docs.foreverlm.com/books): Store book PDFs in the iCloud Books folder and use them as reviewable sources.
- [Courses](https://docs.foreverlm.com/courses): Combine lecture PDFs, book chapters, and video transcripts into course sources.
- [Podcasts](https://docs.foreverlm.com/podcasts): Extract transcripts from Apple Podcasts episodes and review them as sources.
- [X Posts](https://docs.foreverlm.com/x-posts): Sync X bookmarks as sources.
- [Plugins](https://docs.foreverlm.com/external-plugins): Connect supported external services.
- [Build Your Own Plugin](https://docs.foreverlm.com/build-your-own-plugin): Add sources through the open plugin surface.

## Learning

- [Schedule](https://docs.foreverlm.com/schedule): Assign sources to days, move work across the week, and track progress. Completion requires a linked review session.
- [In-App Chat](https://docs.foreverlm.com/in-app-chat): Review sources inside ForeverLM with the configured API provider. Completed sessions link back to sources.
- [Text to Speech](https://docs.foreverlm.com/text-to-speech): Listen to articles and text sources with on-device macOS speech or configured cloud TTS providers.
- [AI Providers & Models](https://docs.foreverlm.com/ai-providers): Managed provider and model selection for chat, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and on-device semantic search.
- [Learning with AI](https://docs.foreverlm.com/learning-with-mcp): Use explain-it-back review and Socratic dialogue with MCP-connected assistants.

## Storage & Privacy

- [iCloud Storage & Privacy](https://docs.foreverlm.com/icloud-storage): How local and synced data are stored.
